title: When the Wilderking Sleeps
summary: Between the high bridge-tiers of Marbruk, the port of Woodhearth, and the living glades of Greenshade, Spinners of Y'ffre seek to mend a severed story-thread that has left the Wilderking's court silent.

hook.rumour: The hollow boughs of the Wilderking's court have gone utterly silent, and the Spinners in Marbruk say someone cut a living memory-root near Woodhearth to bind forest spirits.
hook.notice: SPINNERS OF GREENSHADE & MARBRUK COUNCIL: Seekers wanted to walk the waking glades between Marbruk and Woodhearth and mend the severed story-thread.

npcs.name: Warden of Woodhearth
npcs.greet: The hollow boughs of the Wilderking's court have gone utterly silent, and the Spinners in Marbruk say someone cut a living memory-root near Woodhearth to bind forest spirits.
talk: The trouble across Greenshade began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Woodhearth.
If you mean to help the Spinners' Conclave of Greenshade, start by checking the trail between Woodhearth and Imperial Underground.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Woodhearth
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Imperial Underground is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Imperial Underground toward Rootwater Grove before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Woodhearth so Hearth-Speaker Indaenir can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Rootwater Grove
npcs.greet: You made good time from Imperial Underground. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Wreck of the Blue Wheel.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Wreck of the Blue Wheel with a picked guard.
Once Wreck of the Blue Wheel is cleared, return to Woodhearth to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Woodhearth
npcs.greet: Hearth-Speaker Indaenir awaits word on whether the crisis in Greenshade has been contained.
talk: The elders of Woodhearth have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Greenshade owes you a debt for standing between Woodhearth and ruin.
